title: Hincmar of Reims
fact_summary: Archbishop of Reims (806–882) who kept the Annals of St-Bertin in his last two decades. The annals name the Hungarians in 862.

claims.text: The Mapping Medieval Peoples database gives his dates as 806 to 882 and describes him as “Archbishop of Rheims, politician, annalist”.
claims.certainty_reason: This records what the database record says, read in the open copy linked under Sources.

claims.text: It dates the part of the annals linked to him to 862–882.
claims.certainty_reason: This records what the database record says, read in the open copy linked under Sources.

open_questions.text: The database record for the annals does not itself name an author. Which edition or study sets out who wrote which part?
